title: Quassus
extract:
The Quassus is Xaku's signature warfan, possessing high damage and critical chance along with throwing ethereal daggers from Heavy Attacks that proc  Slash, with these daggers being more accurate in Xaku's hands.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Slash damage.
Stance slot has  polarity, matching  Slicing Feathers and  Votive Onslaught stance.
Heavy Attacks throws a horizontal spread of ethereal daggers, with each dagger doing 76 base damage.
The first heavy attack throws 12 daggers, each with a 2.5x damage multiplier; the second heavy attack in sequence throws 6 daggers, each with a 5x damage multiplier,
Damage of the daggers are affected by mods.
Daggers are considered a heavy attack. Their damage will scale from the combo counter and mods such as  Killing Blow.
Daggers have a guaranteed  Slash proc.
Daggers have innate 2 meter Punch Through.
Dagger damage does not diminish with distance.
Have travel time.
Cannot use Thrown Melee mods  Combo Fury,  Power Throw,  Quick Return ( Volatile),  Rebound ( Volatile), and  Whirlwind.
Multiple projectile hits from one attack against a single enemy may occasionally get merged into a single "instance" of the attack and Bleed proc, reducing the effectiveness of per-hit mods like  Relentless Combination.
Daggers are subject to gravity and are substantially inaccurate over long distances, with vertical deviation being especially apparent.
When wielded by Xaku, accuracy is greatly increased, with both vertical and horizontal deviations almost completely eliminated. The base spread of the daggers is unaffected.
A single dagger may be controlled with Ivara's Navigator.

Known Bugs
Using Alt-Fire while latching onto a wall will result in a bugged heavy attack animation, ending with a roll. Ethereal Daggers will not be thrown.

Notes
Warfan slams hit twice.
Second hit of a heavy slam will use the stats of a normal slam.
The amount of knives thrown by the heavy attack is affected by  Octavia's  Metronome's Opera multishot buff.
 Jet Stream can be used to increase the speed of the daggers.
As it is a melee attack, all four of  Mirage's  Hall of Mirrors throw their own full set of knives with each heavy attack.
Holding the Alt fire button on another weapon and then using the quick melee action will immediately throw Ethereal Daggers.

Trivia
Quassus is Latin for "shaking".
The Quassus was designed by Kedemel.
